meta.title: Advisory HITL evidence reconciliation
meta.purpose: Machine-readable architecture for AI agents and the interactive HTML diagram.
meta.source_of_truth: packages/domain decides. Agents sequence; they do not classify.

constraints.MR-5: Contradiction, Gap, Abstention may be constructed only in packages/domain.
constraints.MR-6: write_audit may be called only from packages/kernel.
constraints.stdlib_packages: packages/ imports stdlib and packages.* only. No third-party.
constraints.time: Derive times from as_of. No datetime.now, time.time, uuid4, or random in packages/.
constraints.challenge_evidence: Do not modify challenge-package evidence. Copy through the copy-set script.
constraints.console: FR-008: the console contains no business rule (BR-064). Notifications are out of scope.

runtime_modes.assessment: Default graded mode. Stdlib only. No network. No model. StdlibOrchestrator.
runtime_modes.ai_disabled: Kill switch. Same regulated fields as assessment. NullInference.
runtime_modes.advisory: Deployed default. LangGraph wrapper. Azure OpenAI narrative if AEGIS_LLM_ENABLED=true.
runtime_modes.ui: FastAPI console. LangGraph wrapper. Inference not allowed even if LLM env is on.
runtime_modes.cloud: Demo adapters (Redis, MCP HTTP, Blob WORM). Never required to grade.

env.AEGIS_LLM_ENABLED: Honoured in every mode; forced false in assessment and ai_disabled.
env.AEGIS_ALLOW_KEY_AUTH: Must be 'dev' for a live Azure call.

nodes.label: HITL reviewer
nodes.tooltip: Qualified person, safety physician, supply governance, or auditor. Opens a pack, opens critical evidence, then acknowledges or contests. Judgement is the output. Acknowledgement is not a signature and not a disposition.
nodes.produces: reviewer_action on the evidence chain
nodes.must_not: Release, reject, allocate, ship, code a case, confirm a signal, or decide eligibility.

nodes.label: aegis CLI
nodes.tooltip: Stdlib façade: setup, run, test, evaluate, reset, evidence-export, verify-evidence, serve, mcp. python -m aegis. Imports packages/* only except serve/mcp which reach services/.
nodes.produces: Canonical JSON pack on stdout (run); HTTP console (serve); stdio MCP (mcp).
nodes.must_not: Classify contradictions or write audit events itself.

nodes.label: MCP host
nodes.tooltip: Cursor or another MCP client. Talks to the read-only AEGIS engine over HTTP /mcp or stdio. Advisory only. Catalog ids: NCB204-B24071, PV-1001, SH-901.
nodes.produces: Tool calls: get_evidence_pack, get_evidence_item, explain_abstention, get_inject_coverage, get_graph_neighbourhood.
nodes.must_not: Mutate packs or acknowledge through MCP. Tools are read-only.

nodes.label: Stdlib HTTP
nodes.tooltip: ThreadingHTTPServer + ConsoleHandler. Zero-install assessment console. dispatch() is the single router. Used when FastAPI is not installed.
nodes.produces: HTML from console.py and JSON from handle().
nodes.must_not: Compute remaining-critical or SoD in the transport.

nodes.label: FastAPI + uvicorn
nodes.tooltip: Optional ui/cloud transport. Catch-all delegates to the same dispatch(..., renderer='jinja'). Not required to grade. Absent from packages/.
nodes.produces: Same routes as stdlib, Jinja templates from apps/web/templates/.
nodes.must_not: Own business rules or a second API surface.

nodes.label: MCP server
nodes.tooltip: JSON-RPC over stdio (python -m aegis mcp) or POST /mcp. handle_rpc → call_tool. Pack chat uses the same tools via ask.answer_question.
nodes.produces: Read-only tool results. Console ask adds a deterministic narrative, not a live model tool-choice.
nodes.must_not: Let the model pick the tool. ask.py routes from question text.

nodes.label: dispatch()
nodes.tooltip: Single HTTP router for pages, static, session cookie, /api/*, HTMX fragments, and /mcp. Form POSTs to /api/reviews/* return a toast fragment when HX-Request is set.
nodes.produces: HTML documents, HTMX fragments, or JSON.
nodes.must_not: Assemble or classify a pack.

nodes.label: JSON API handle()
nodes.tooltip: Canonical API. GET workflows load a fixture and run the orchestrator. GET /api/evidence/{id} marks opened. POST acknowledge/contest are the only mutations. SoD and critical-evidence gates are re-checked on POST.
nodes.produces: Validated pack JSON; review events; health; history; ask answers.
nodes.must_not: Introduce a regulated-action route (BR-068).

nodes.label: HITL console
nodes.tooltip: Server-rendered FR-008 console. Formats packs; computes no rule (BR-064). Pages: Dashboard, Batch, PV, Supply, Contradictions, Status, Evidence history, Gates, Injects, Agents, Runtime health. HTMX for evidence drawer and follow-up save.
nodes.produces: HTML. Toast 'Data saved' after Store follow-up as evidence.
nodes.must_not: Derive, round, sort, or reconcile values. No notification inbox (FR-008 out of scope).

nodes.label: OrchestratorPort
nodes.tooltip: resolve_orchestrator() returns StdlibOrchestrator. services/integration/langgraph/resolve.py wraps it in advisory/ui/cloud when langgraph is installed.
nodes.produces: A runner that executes DECLARED_STEPS in order.
nodes.must_not: Let the model choose the next step (BR-049).

nodes.label: StdlibOrchestrator
nodes.tooltip: begin → advance each declared step → finish. Budget admission and wallet check in begin. Domain work happens in the package step via kernel packs. Assessment always uses this runner.
nodes.produces: Final pack dict plus human_review.orchestration metadata.
nodes.must_not: Construct Contradiction, Gap, or Abstention.

nodes.label: LangGraph adapter
nodes.tooltip: StateGraph nodes are the nine DECLARED_STEPS. Each node calls StdlibOrchestrator.advance. Optional interrupt_on_approve. Falls back to StdlibOrchestrator if langgraph is missing.
nodes.produces: Same pack as the stdlib runner. Optional gate_outcome: awaiting_human.
nodes.must_not: Put domain classification in a LangGraph node.

nodes.label: DECLARED_STEPS
nodes.tooltip: admit → plan → retrieve → project_graph → reconcile → annotate → approve → package → validate_emit. Roles: kernel, AG-1…AG-6. Workflow agents: batch AG-3, PV AG-4, supply AG-5.
nodes.produces: Fixed step order and role_for_step(step, workflow).
nodes.must_not: Be chosen or reordered by a model.

nodes.label: start_request
nodes.tooltip: Request bootstrap: interpreter guard, write_audit(request_start), authorize, derive_request_id from as_of. Returns request_id, mode, authorization, execution_status, llm_enabled.
nodes.produces: Request context dict.
nodes.must_not: Use wall-clock time or uuid4.

nodes.label: authorize
nodes.tooltip: Purpose + role + entitlement check. Unregistered purpose is a deny. checked_at is derived from as_of. Entitlements are live-loaded, never cached.
nodes.produces: {user, purpose, checked_at, decision}.
nodes.must_not: Cache authz, consent, hold, or residency (AP-9).

nodes.label: write_audit
nodes.tooltip: Sole audit writer (MR-6). Call sites: lifecycle, authz, checkpoint, privacy, packs. Review acknowledge/contest also write through handlers → kernel.
nodes.produces: In-process audit trail records.
nodes.must_not: Be imported or called from services, domain, or the console.

nodes.label: kernel packs
nodes.tooltip: batch_pack, pv_pack, supply_pack, advisory_pack. Start request, privacy, domain reconcile_*, sort, emission controls, persist_run. Then optional inference annotation.
nodes.produces: Schema-valid pack with execution_status=not_executed.
nodes.must_not: Construct classification types. Only assemble .as_dict() outputs.

nodes.label: privacy + checkpoint
nodes.tooltip: evaluate_privacy, apply_emission_controls, filter_withheld_subjects. Checkpoint freshness and replay live in kernel/checkpoint.py. Replay is idempotent by input hash.
nodes.produces: Filtered fixture and emission-controlled pack. Replay bytes when fresh.
nodes.must_not: Cache privacy or hold state.

nodes.label: reconcile_batch
nodes.tooltip: Workflow A / AG-3 / FR-001. Genealogy vs warehouse, OOS LIMS, organism ID, unit-mapping abstentions, cleaning-boundary gaps, PAT/recipe desync. Readiness: insufficient_evidence | conflicted_evidence | ready_for_authorized_review.
nodes.produces: evidence, contradictions, gaps, abstentions, applicable_documents, readiness_state.
nodes.must_not: Dispose a batch or pick a winner on a contradiction.

nodes.label: reconcile_pv
nodes.tooltip: Workflow B / AG-4 / FR-002. Language-out-of-scope abstentions, social minimum-criteria gaps, listedness contradictions, duplicate candidates, MedDRA coding retained, required_reviews.
nodes.produces: source_facts, duplicate_candidates, clock_evidence, terminology, listedness_context, classifications.
nodes.must_not: Code a case, confirm a signal, or decide listedness.

nodes.label: reconcile_supply
nodes.tooltip: Workflow C / AG-5 / FR-003. Cold-chain logger contradictions, serialisation gaps, CMO overcommit findings, recall-scope abstention. Options are draft and never ranked.
nodes.produces: options[], constraints[], quality_holds[], approvals_required[], classifications.
nodes.must_not: Allocate, reserve, ship, or present an unqualified substitute as available supply.

nodes.label: Contradiction / Gap / Abstention
nodes.tooltip: The only place these types may be constructed (MR-5 / ADR-002). .as_dict() feeds pack arrays. IntegrityFailure extends Abstention in evidence.py.
nodes.produces: Classification objects for pack arrays.
nodes.must_not: Be constructed outside packages/domain. Module-boundary gate fails the build.

nodes.label: Advisory engines
nodes.tooltip: reconcile_clinical, regulatory, continuity, interfaces, authority, tools, finops, links. Merged by advisory_pack for PUB-09…15 style fixtures. Still domain-owned classifications.
nodes.produces: Advisory pack body for non-A/B/C workflows.
nodes.must_not: Relax the advisory_nonexecuting contract.

nodes.label: Graph projection
nodes.tooltip: In-process property graph from RELATIONSHIP_MODEL.csv. Never a system of record. Trust gate: untrusted nodes cannot source grounding edges. Forbidden: RELEASED, ALLOCATED_TO, SIGNAL_CONFIRMED.
nodes.produces: Projection + graph_summary on human_review.graph_projection.
nodes.must_not: Persist to Cosmos DB or encode a regulated disposition as an edge.

nodes.label: Ontology
nodes.tooltip: Units (compare, never convert), identity tiers, preserve_time, terminology, trust_for_document, embedded-instruction scanner. Describes disagreement; does not resolve it.
nodes.produces: ComparisonResult, Identifier, TimePoint, Coding, TrustStatus.
nodes.must_not: Apply an unapproved unit mapping or invent a converted value.

nodes.label: FinOps
nodes.tooltip: admit_budgets, exhausted(steps|tokens|tool_calls), wallet ceiling, price_tokens from model_costs.csv (listed large-1). Partial cost: missing human review, platform, observability.
nodes.produces: Budget dict, stop reason, priced token costs on llm chain records.
nodes.must_not: Estimate tokens. Cost is recorded_tokens × listed unit price or unpriced.

nodes.label: Contracts + deny-list
nodes.tooltip: Stdlib JSON Schema subset. batch/pv/supply/evidence_item + advisory_nonexecuting. grade() / assert_clean() deny execution language. invariants: execution_status == not_executed.
nodes.produces: SchemaError, DenyListError, or a clean pack.
nodes.must_not: Default an unknown response_contract.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.tooltip: runtime_mode, llm_enabled, inference_allowed, roles.yaml, entitlements.yaml, agents.yaml, budgets, PURPOSE_REGISTER, catalog entities, paths. Kill switch is AEGIS_LLM_ENABLED and ai_disabled mode.
nodes.produces: Mode, entitlements, agent capability boundaries, entity catalog.
nodes.must_not: Cache entitlements or hold state.

nodes.label: InferencePort
nodes.tooltip: Protocol. resolve_inference() default is NullInference. Azure adapter is set from services via set_inference_port. advice must not import domain.
nodes.produces: {called, annotations?, reason, tokens}.
nodes.must_not: Write regulated pack fields. Annotations only, labelled model-generated.

nodes.label: Azure OpenAI
nodes.tooltip: FR-013 only. Narrative summary of an already-computed pack. Live call only with AEGIS_ALLOW_KEY_AUTH=dev, residency and model-version checks. Assessment uses stub_advice. Pack chat does not call this for tool choice.
nodes.produces: human_review.annotations + persist_llm (hash, tokens, cost). Never the prompt body.
nodes.must_not: Change findings, contradictions, gaps, abstentions, or readiness_state.

nodes.label: NullInference
nodes.tooltip: Default and kill-switch adapter. generate() returns called=False, reason=null. Assessment and ai_disabled always land here.
nodes.produces: Empty annotation result. Pack regulated fields unchanged.
nodes.must_not: Be bypassed in assessment.

nodes.label: Advice guards G-1…G-5
nodes.tooltip: guard_advice(pack, advice). Fail-closed. Evidence brief is minimised; prompt SHA-256 stored, not the prompt. Cassettes replay by prompt hash for evals.
nodes.produces: {passed, check, reason?, advice?}.
nodes.must_not: Pass ungrounded or execution-shaped model text into the pack.

nodes.label: persist_run / llm / review
nodes.tooltip: Append-only writer. persist_run writes request, inputs, pack hash, decisions, audit tail, outcome. persist_llm writes tokens and listed cost. persist_review writes reviewer_action (signature=false, execution=false).
nodes.produces: Hash-chained JSONL records.
nodes.must_not: Store API keys, patient_id, or prompt plaintext (scan.assert_clean_payload).

nodes.label: Evidence chain
nodes.tooltip: out/evidence/chains/<request_id>.jsonl. Record types: request, inputs, pack, decisions, audit, review, llm, guard, outcome, expiry, hold_refusal. verify_chain / verify_all.
nodes.produces: Append-only ledger. History page reads review records.
nodes.must_not: Be rewritten. Expiry of llm records is retention, not silent delete of the run.

nodes.label: runtime_health
nodes.tooltip: In-process rollup of chains + kernel audit. Tokens, listed LLM cost, denials, wallet, deployments. Explicitly not OpenTelemetry. No collector or exporter.
nodes.produces: /api/health snapshot and the Runtime health page.
nodes.must_not: Add an OTel SDK under packages/.

nodes.label: Pack chat
nodes.tooltip: POST /api/ask. Deterministic tool router from the question text, then a labelled model restatement of the tool result only (narrate.py). Not a disposition. Floating panel, not a notification inbox.
nodes.produces: Tool card + narrative blocks in #engine-thread.
nodes.must_not: Act, dispose, or let the model choose tools.

nodes.label: Status + contradictions
nodes.tooltip: Work queue for packs in this process. Acknowledge and Store follow-up as evidence. Contradictions board keeps both positions; contest stores action_taken against subject_id. HTMX stays on the page and shows Data saved.
nodes.produces: review records + in-memory follow-up timeline.
nodes.must_not: Settle a disagreement or act as a signature.

nodes.label: Evidence history
nodes.tooltip: list_review_events() over all chain files. Acknowledgements, contests, evidence_opened. The ledger, not the work queue. Status is the queue; this page is the chain.
nodes.produces: /history table and /api/history JSON.
nodes.must_not: Treat a review row as a 21 CFR Part 11 signature.

nodes.label: Synthetic fixtures
nodes.tooltip: Hash-verified copy set. PUB-01…15 public fixtures, CSVs including RELATIONSHIP_MODEL.csv, model_costs.csv, knowledge docs. Challenge package evidence is never modified here.
nodes.produces: Inputs to engines, graph, and listed token prices.
nodes.must_not: Be edited as if it were the challenge package.

flows.name: CLI batch run (assessment)
flows.description: Graded path. No network, no model. Engines classify; orchestrator sequences; pack is persisted and printed.

steps.action: Walk admit…validate_emit. Model does not choose.
persist_run: request, inputs, pack, decisions, outcome.

flows.name: CLI PV intake
flows.description: Workflow B. Same orchestrator; pv_pack → reconcile_pv. No case coding.

flows.name: CLI supply / cold-chain
flows.description: Workflow C. Options are draft and unranked. No allocation.

steps.action: reconcile_supply: logger contradictions, holds, draft options.

flows.name: Console loads a pack
flows.description: Reviewer opens Batch/PV/Supply. Transport is stdlib or FastAPI; both call dispatch → handle → orchestrator.

steps.action: persist_run if this request is new.
render_pack_body: findings, both contradiction positions, evidence table.

flows.name: HITL acknowledge
flows.description: Forced evidence view then acknowledge. Server re-checks outstanding critical items and segregation of duties. Not a signature.

steps.action: Acknowledge control appears only when outstanding_critical is empty.
POST /api/reviews/{id}/acknowledge. Refuse if preparer==reviewer or items remain.

flows.name: Store follow-up as evidence
flows.description: Contest / action_taken on Status or Contradictions. HTMX keeps the page; toast confirms. Ledger is the chain.

steps.action: Write action taken. Click Store follow-up as evidence.
HX-Request → fragment + OOB toast, no navigation.
Visible on Evidence history as a decision row.

flows.name: Pack chat
flows.description: Advisory chatbot. Deterministic tool pick, then a labelled restatement. Not a disposition.

steps.action: Ask: What is the status of NCB204-B24071?
Router selects get_evidence_pack from the text.
Run if the pack is not loaded.
Tool card + model-generated summary labelled not a disposition.

flows.name: MCP get_evidence_pack
flows.description: External agent (Cursor) reads a pack. Read-only. Same handle() as the console.

flows.name: Azure annotation (advisory)
flows.description: FR-013. Model restates an already-computed pack. Guards fail-closed. Tokens and listed cost go on the chain. Regulated arrays stay byte-identical to assessment.

steps.action: LangGraph adapter or stdlib; same steps.
evidence_brief + generate. Live only if key-auth=dev.

flows.name: Kill switch / ai_disabled
flows.description: Same regulated pack as assessment. InferencePort is NullInference. Console still serves.

steps.action: persist_run without an llm record (or uncalled).

flows.name: Nine declared steps
flows.description: The only legal control flow. AG roles are declared in agents.yaml. Domain work is inside package, not in plan/retrieve placeholders.

steps.action: reconcile — AG-3/4/5 role; work occurs in package.
annotate — workflow agent; model only if allowed.

flows.name: FinOps budget stop
flows.description: If steps, tokens, or tool_calls exhaust, orchestrator emits a partial pack with a domain Abstention and persists it. Not a retry storm.

flows.name: Runtime health
flows.description: In-process telemetry from the evidence chain. Not OpenTelemetry. Listed LLM cost from recorded tokens.

steps.action: Load chains; sum tokens and llm records.
price_tokens for the rollup. Wallet remaining.
KPI cards, deployments, recent llm, kill switch.

flows.name: Evidence history ledger
flows.description: Read path for reviewer_action records. Complements Status (queue) without becoming a notification panel.

steps.action: Table of event, entity, user, action_taken, request, seq.

flows.name: Graph projection
flows.description: Ephemeral in-process graph. Presentation on the pack. Forbidden edges cannot be represented.

steps.action: Pack page shows the projection. MCP get_graph_neighbourhood reads it.
